_meta.purpose: Hand-labeled fixture for SemanticCloneDetector --calibrate. Each pair is (function_a, function_b, label). Used to sweep cosine thresholds and find the F1-optimum for each embedding model. Re-run on every model swap.

labels.clone: Type-4 semantic clone — same observable behavior, different syntax/structure
labels.non_clone: Different observable behavior — flagging these is a false positive

categories.function-vs-arrow: Imperative function vs arrow form of same operation
categories.control-flow: Early return vs nested-if; switch vs object lookup
categories.async-pattern: async/await vs Promise.then; callback vs Promise
categories.data-shape: Different data structures, same algorithm (array vs object iteration)
categories.guard-vs-validate: Throw on invalid vs return null/undefined; same intent
categories.domain-different: Different domain entirely — strong negative example
categories.near-miss: Same domain, similar surface, different behavior — hardest negative
categories.primitive-difference: Adjacent operations: push/pop, sort asc/desc, get/set

_meta.source: Hand-curated 2026-05-20 for nomic-embed-text-v1.5 calibration. Functions are minimal TypeScript snippets representative of real code review surface.
